tweet: "Dont try to make yourself remember, darling Dont look for me, Im just a story youve been told So lets pretend a little longer Cause when were gone, Everything goes on"
"If only dying didn't cause grief to my family then I would already be dead. Sometimes I wish I never existed in the first place."
"Still bouncing between groups of friends because I fit in none of them"
"Is life really worth living for?"
"I wonder what it feels like to have someone hit you up to say they want to have your company"
"I should be happy for my friend's streaming career, but deep down my true nature is full of jealousy. Why am I like this"
"So I'm talking to myself right, and he's such a fucking asshole. Oh wait, that is actually me."
"Funny how my personality did a 180, and now I'm back to being 100% introverted."
"I have many issues that I need to fix about myself. But the one preventing me from fixing myself is... myself. I am my own worst enemy."
"I wonder what it feels like to get ideas, and actually follow through with them"
"Apparently I have been diagnosed with ADHD, and Depression that has gone untreated for many years now. I don't know how I am even functioning at this point."
"I wonder what it feels like to have actual friend and family support"
"Why should I support others when they don't even support me back. Actually why do I even bother with people in the first place. It's better to be off alone."
"Selling the rest of my life span for money sounds really good right now."
"What the point of even trying anything if in the end it achieves nothing. I try all I want, and none of my effort ever pays off. What is the point in trying to keep going on in life?"

"My entire life is just full of failures. Never had I achieve anything that I can truly say that I reached that point myself. Everything was just given to me. In the end, it never feels like I really earned it myself."

"Never in my life have I felt like I truly accomplished anything worth talking about in my life. All my achievements have only been getting them in video games, and that is the meaningless thing I like to brag about,"
"I used to care a lot at one point in my life. Then it all changed when I got hurt, and realized that no one cared. Then I stopped caring, and it was all downhill from there."
"I always wondered, if I ever do disappear one day... will anything change at all? If my existent didn't affect them in the first place, will my disappearance even matter at all."
"Honestly, don't even remember I was genuinely happy at all. I mean, I have moments where like I do feel excited, and such. But, I don't remember ever really feeling genuine happiness."
"Sometimes I wonder if I'm really getting better, or I'm just so apathetic that I stopped caring about everything. But sometimes this sadness just comes back without me even realizing it."

"How can I be satisfied with my own successes when all my life, I have been compared to everyone around me. How can be confident in my own abilities, when I keep getting told that everyone that there are people doing better than me."
"Debating if I should continue onto next year. Like I told myself over, and over again for the past 15 years. I always ask if it gets better next year. In the end, nothing changes at all."
"If you knew the real me, you would hate me. That is why I put on this fake persona to be likable."
"I have lived all my life in the state of anger. The whole world pisses me off, and I hate everyone."
"If you're gonna accidently invite me to something. Then make a better fucking excuse than saying your game was glitching. That you didn't mean to fucking invite me in the first place."
"There is nothing in this world, that will be able to fill the empty void within me."

"I took your heart, and made it mine Do my best to justify it Call it pleasure but it feels like pain So how'd we let it get this way? Your broken heart was just like mine We built these walls and hid inside 'em I said I wouldn't let you in And now you know I'm paper-thin"
"I care too much about the people that don't care about me. The day I stop caring, I will be gone from this world."
"I chose the name Soulless because I lack empathy. I'm just a husk for the person I used to be. I lost myself a long time ago. Now I'm just an empty person with no feelings."
"I hate this world. I hate fake people. But I really hate myself the most."
"The other day, I lost the last person I can call a close friend. I guess this is what you can call a friend breakup."
